Next.js 16 App Router club management system for TJ Sokol Svinov (Czech handball club): TypeScript strict, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest. UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use `.claude/skills/` proactively when applicable: `/new-entity` for new DB table, data model, or CRUD feature. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill. `/db-sync` after any DB migration is applied or TypeScript types are out of sync with schema. `/new-migration` when a new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy needs creation. `/generate-barrels` after adding, renaming, or removing any hook, component, type, or enum file. Run before committing. `/review-pr` for code review, PR review, or "check my changes". Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity layout:
- `src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (AUTO-GENERATED); `data/{camelCase}.ts` (domain types extending schema)
- `src/queries/{pluralCamel}/`: `constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (read), `mutations.ts` (write), `index.ts` (barrel). All query/mutation functions in `src/queries/` receive `ctx: QueryContext` as first argument and use `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.
- `src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts` (createDataFetchHook); `state/use{Entity}.ts` (createCRUDHook)
- `src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts` (Czech strings)

Use the right client: browser `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client`; server `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server`; authenticated API `withAuth(handler)`, admin API `withAdminAuth(handler)`, public API `withPublicAccess(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`; coach role checks `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` (auth helpers, not clients).
Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa.
Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes — they handle auth, 401/403, and error responses consistently.

These files are **auto-generated** — never edit manually, always regenerate: `src/hooks/index.ts`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/components/index.ts`.
These files are **manual** — always update by hand: `src/lib/api-routes.ts`, `src/lib/translations/index.ts`.
Component barrel generator: `scripts/generate-component-exports.mjs`. File-level opt-out: add `// <REDACTED_USER>` on any of first 5 lines of `.ts`/`.tsx`. Folder-level: empty `.barrel-ignore` inside directory. Use for non-public helper files; generator logs `⏭️  Skipping ...`.

Use layout components instead of raw Tailwind flex/grid classes. **Important:** Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). All layout components use static lookup maps to generate classes. Follow this pattern when creating new layout components.
Use `<Grid columns={3} gap="md">`, `<GridItem span={2}>`, `<HStack spacing={2}>`, and `<VStack spacing={4}>`; don't use manual grid/flex classes, `col-span-X`, or `space-y-X`. Components: `src/components/ui/Grid/Grid.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Grid/components/GridItem.tsx`, `src/components/ui/HStack/HStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/VStack/VStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Stack/Stack.tsx`.
